balls.text: has Hazlewood been run out at the batter's end?! Well, that might be immaterial because he has been run out at the other end! Back of a length on leg. Hazlewood stays leg side of the ball and pokes at it. Gets beaten on the outside. Hazlewood wanders out of his ground and then has to try and stretch back, with Buttler hitting the stumps. Once that happens, Bhuvneshwar decides to pinch a run and Hazlewood has to then hurtle to the other end. The ball, having hit the stumps, rolls around on the pitch and Gill is first to react. He picks it up and throws down the stumps at the bowler's end, with Hazlewood just about in the frame. RCB bowled out for 155!

heaved to deep mid wicket, and Sudharsan lunges forward to take it! Slot ball outside off and Iyer gives it all he has. The ball pings off the inner half of the bat, though, and arrows towards Sudharsan. He dives forward and then rolls to retain control of the ball. The third umpire does check if the catch is clean and he says it is. Iyer has to depart!
banged in short on middle and off. Iyer fends it towards backward point and keeps strike for the start of the 20th
four more! Very full just outside off. Iyer plants his front foot, goes through the line and razes it back past the bowler!
short and wide outside off. Seems like a slower ball and Iyer slashes it over backward point. Back for a couple of runs
back of a length on the stumps. Bhuvneshwar nudges it into the cover point region and gets Iyer on strike
oh, hello! Bhuvneshwar finds the fence again with another solid strike. Back of a length outside off and Bhuvneshwar crashes it to sweeper cover's right!
back of a length just outside off. Bhuvneshwar gets up on his toes and taps it towards extra cover
back of a length on middle and off. Bhuvneshwar hops up onto his toes and drops it into the off side to retain strike
full on middle and off. Bhuvneshwar comes half forward and prods it towards extra cover
short, wide and punished! Sits up nicely and Bhuvneshwar has enough width to work with too. Gets on top of the bounce and thrashes it past extra cover!
on a length just outside off and this seams away with the angle. Bhuvneshwar wafts at it without any footwork and is beaten
length ball, angling into the pads. Iyer works it towards deep square leg and is content with a single
ouch - that will hurt! Shortish on middle and off. Iyer has a huge swipe across the line and misses. Too early into the stroke and he gets tagged on the left elbow
bashed half-way down outside off and this balloons over the batter. Easy decision for the umpire once Iyer lets it go
back of a length outside off. Bhuvneshwar waits on it before patting it to backward point
dug in short just outside off. Iyer hares down the track and flat-bats it to long on
dug in short on leg. Iyer has a huge swing at it but squirts it off the inside half of the bat towards short fine leg
back of a length outside off. Bhuvneshwar gets up on his toes and dabs it behind point
darted in fuller outside off. Iyer looks for the scoop again but makes a hash of it for the second ball running. Off the pad into the on side
well well! Back of a length on middle and off. Iyer shuffles across and looks for the scoop, but does not lay bat on ball
back of a length just outside off. Bhuvneshwar stays back and plays it to extra cover
googly on a length just outside off. Bhuvneshwar comes forward and blocks
zipped through on a length on off. Bhuvneshwar lets the ball come to him before meeting it right under his eyes
length on middle and off. Iyer reads it off the pitch and turns it into the on side
back of a length on leg and this skids through. Iyer gets trapped on the crease and manages a scratch before getting struck on the back leg. Good for him he did
flighted up full on the pads. Iyer plays all around it and the ball dribbles off the pad into the on side
shortish outside off and this kicks up a little. Iyer waits on it and runs it down to deep third
shortish outside off. Bhuvneshwar jumps up onto his toes and drops it into the off side with soft hands
back of a length on off. Bhuvneshwar gets up on his toes and defends
length just outside off. Iyer gets onto the front foot and pokes it to mid off to open his account

angled in full on middle and off. Bhuvneshwar comes forward and clips it past mid on. Siraj chases after it, having not dived earlier, and he puts in a sprawl just before the ball hits the rope. His parry nearly rolls into the cushion, only to be saved by Suthar's tumble. Boundary saved, just.

oh dear - what have you done, Romario Shepherd?! Hard length outside off and under ordinary circumstances, this was there to be hit. But perhaps not at 126-7. Shepherd, though, gives in to the temptation and shanks it terribly. Straight to Sudharsan, and GT continue to pile misery on RCB!

chopped on, and Rashid strikes again! Slipped through on a back of a length on middle and leg. Seems like the slider and it skids through. Padikkal wants to cut it off his stumps but the lack of room means he chops it onto his pad, before the ball bobbles onto the stumps. RCB seven down, and in a heap of trouble now!
slower and hung up a little more outside off on a length. Shepherd has a pop at it and drags it to long on
this is another mighty hit - Shepherd is going for it now! On a length on middle and off. Shepherd clears his front leg and smokes it over wide long on!
back of a length on middle and off. Shepherd hangs back and pokes it towards the bowler, who fields it and then mimics a throw at the other end
Shepherd goes massive! Googly that lands in the slot outside off. Shepherd picks it, goes through the line and pumps it over the bowler's head!
fizzed through on a length outside off. Spins away a touch and rips past the outside edge of Shepherd's dangling blade
back of a length outside off. Shepherd drops it into the point region and keeps strike
back of a length outside off. Shepherd presses half forward and jabs it towards backward point
back of a length on the stumps. Padikkal opens his bat face and dabs it towards backward point. Shepherd swift enough to pinch a single, despite a direct hit
short and smashed! Rabada gets good height on this, but Padikkal also gets plenty on it. Takes his eyes off the ball a touch but manages to hook it convincingly over short fine leg!

shot! Back of a length on middle and leg. Padikkal gives himself room, gets on top of the bounce and threads it between mid off and extra cover. Gill sprawls while chasing but is in contact with the rope while also touching the ball. Much-needed boundary!
lbw shout, not given! Back of a length on middle and leg, and this nips in. Shepherd, caught on the crease, gets rapped on the pad but that may have been sliding down with the angle. Leg bye taken
on a length outside off. Padikkal goes back and jabs it towards extra cover
floated up full on middle and off. Shepherd plants his front foot and powers it on the bounce to long on
back of a length outside off and this fizzes off the surface. Shepherd has a poke at it and gets beaten on the outside
very full on the pads again. Padikkal tucks it off his toes towards long on
zipped in very full but this may have pitched just outside leg. Padikkal plays all around it and gets pinged on the pad
flighted up full on the stumps. Shepherd comes forward and knocks it to long on
banged in short on leg. Shepherd hops up onto his toes and tugs it towards deep backward square leg
fullish on middle and leg. Shepherd gets onto the front foot and pushes it to mid on
full just outside off. Shepherd gets a half stride forward and stabs it towards backward point

another tame chip to mid wicket, and Holder is like a catching magnet tonight! He would catch a cold in the desert! Back of a length on middle and leg. A bit of hold in the surface and Krunal, like many before him, cannot keep his flick down. Pops it straight to Holder, and Arshad is over the moon. RCB six down, and under the pump!
Krunal gets his first boundary! Shortish outside off and there is just enough width to work with for Krunal. He frees his arms and knifes it past backward point!
back of a length on off. Padikkal stands up tall and knocks it to long on
fullish on leg. Krunal gets onto the front foot and turns it gently towards mid wicket
flighted up full outside leg. Krunal cuts himself off with a big stride and the ball bobbles off his pad into the on side

sharp grab by Holder, and Rashid is into the act again! Googly fizzed in full on off. David gets down on one knee and looks to mow it over cow corner. Shanks it off the inside half of the bat and the ball flies towards Holder at short mid wicket, who leaps into the air and clasps his palms around it. No problem with this catch, and RCB are now five down!
dragged down outside off. Padikkal hops back and tugs it towards deep mid wicket. That stopped a little in the pitch too
flighted up full on off. David plants his front foot and drills it to long off
back of a length outside off. David throws his hands at it and slices his cut. On the bounce to backward point
shortish outside off. David gets up on his toes and cuts it towards deep point
dispatched with utter disdain! Half-tracker outside off and this sits up just the way David wants. He winds up and wallops it flat over mid wicket!
banged in short on middle. Padikkal gives himself room and flat-bats it to long on
shortish on leg stump. Padikkal cramped for room on the pull and helps it towards short fine leg
short and wide outside off. David rolls his wrists and cuts it towards sweeper cover

Buttler flies to his right, and Jitesh's woes continue! Hung up on a length wide outside off. Jitesh goes for the booming cover drive but does not move his feet a great deal. Musters a healthy edge and Buttler snaps down low to his right to hand GT their fourth wicket!
back of a length outside off. Jitesh goes back and pats it into the off side to open his account
back of a length on middle and off. Jitesh gets behind the line of the ball and defends

goes straight up, and Holder has somehow managed to hold on! Banged into the track on middle and leg, and this seems to stick in the surface. Patidar looks for the pick-up pull but top-edges it. Holder runs around to his right from deep square and despite the presence of Rabada, who was running back from short fine, Holder lunges to his right and makes it stick in his mitts. Arshad has a wicket, and Patidar has to go. But hang on. The replays have come up on the screen, and Kohli is very animated with the fourth umpire beyond the ropes. And Kohli continues to moan. Looks like Patidar's dismissal has been confirmed, and RCB are not at all happy!
banged in short on leg and this skips through. Patidar opts to duck under it early and manages it without much fuss
shortish on the hips. Patidar hops around before dinking it into the mid wicket region. Calls for two and saunters back
dumped over the fence! This is a half-tracker, sitting up on middle and leg. Patidar picks it up and deposits it over mid wicket!
shortish outside off. Patidar gets up on his toes and punches it down to long on
back of a length, following the batter outside leg. Padikkal, having stepped down, tucks it towards deep backward square leg
back of a length just outside off. Patidar opens his bat face and runs it down to deep third
back of a length just outside off. Padikkal plays it very late and nudges it past the keeper. Deep third is fine and can cut it off
shortish again, and Padikkal goes to the other side of the sweeper now! Uses the width, closes his bat face a touch and slaps it to sweeper cover's left!
welcomed with a boundary! Shortish outside off. Padikkal moves to the leg side early and slices it over backward point!
shortish on leg. Padikkal hangs back and tucks it off his hips towards deep backward square leg
back of a length on middle and off. Patidar opens his bat face and dabs it towards backward point
back of a length on middle and off, and this skips through too. Patidar hops around his crease before dropping it into the off side. This was bowled at 149.4kph
back of a length on off. Patidar lets the ball come to him before running it down to short third

Patidar done all ends up, but he somehow still gets four! Hard length on middle and off and this rears up. Patidar does not know what to do about it and hangs out his bat in hope in the end, while also taking his eyes off it. The ball skews off the leading edge and lands between short third and deep backward point, who was moving to his left!
shortish outside off, bowled at 146.1kph and this zips through. Patidar swishes at it but is beaten for pace
just over! Banged in short on leg, and this gets big on Padikkal. Cramps him for room on the pull too and he splices it just beyond mid wicket!
back of a length on middle and off. Padikkal walks down the track before turning it towards mid wicket
back of a length just outside off. Padikkal rises with the bounce and taps it into the off side with soft hands
sliced, and four more! Back of a length just outside off. Padikkal backs away, throws his hands at it and slashes it over short third!
Padikkal goes big now! Marginally short just outside off and Padikkal climbs into it. He gets his front hip out of the way and whacks it over mid wicket!
back of a length just outside off. Padikkal gets up on his toes and pokes it towards extra cover
shortish just outside off. Patidar hops around his crease before dropping it into the off side with soft hands
hard length on middle and off. Patidar hops up onto his toes and prods it towards the bowler
Patidar is up and running too! Pushed in on a length on middle and off. Patidar comes forward, shows the maker's name and cracks it back past the bowler!
slanted in on a length on off. Patidar presses half forward and defends

clothed up, and Rabada has his revenge! Kudos to the bowler for coming back strong, but also to the captain for persisting with him. This is banged in short, following the batter outside leg. Kohli, stepping out to swipe at it, gets cramped for room. The ball spews up off the splice and Rashid, moving to his right from mid wicket, slides and completes the catch. GT go back-to-back!
back of a length just outside off. Kohli hangs back and jams it off the inside edge into his pad
length ball sliding down leg. Kohli misses his flick and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
back of a length just outside off. Padikkal gets up on his toes and pats it into the off side
shortish and slanting across the batter outside off. Padikkal goes wafting at it and only connects with fresh air

chipped straight to mid wicket, and Siraj breaks through! Fullish on the pads and this is there to be hit. Bethell looks to clip it away but cannot keep it down. Does not get under it either and he could not have picked out Rashid better. Some respite for GT, even if it is not of the man who has caused havoc so far, but they will take it nonetheless!
back of a length, following the batter outside leg. Kohli has a swipe at it and seems to miss, with the ball rolling off his body into the on side
this is majestic! Slanted in on a length on off. Kohli marches down the track and slams it flat over mid on. This is a batting clinic!
oh! Length just outside off and this decks back in sharply. Kohli stabs at it and gets an inside edge before getting rapped on the pad
much fuller outside off. Kohli comes forward and pushes it back to the bowler, who gets his boot in the way and parries it to mid on

and it just keeps getting better! My word - this is some display of stroke-making! Hung up on a length outside off. Kohli stays on top of the bounce and crunches it between cover point and extra cover!
four fours in a row, and Kohli is having a ball already! This is shorter but there is width on offer again. Kohli opens his bat face and glides it to deep backward point's left!
four more, and Kohli is ripping Rabada apart early! Fullish outside off and shaping away. Kohli leans forward, covers the swing and square-drives it beautifully past backward point!
this is even better! Back of a length outside off. Kohli stands up tall on the front foot and thumps it over mid off on the up!
Kohli lands his first punch too! Banged in short outside off. Not a lot of conviction in the ball but plenty in the shot. Kohli rocks back and hammers it over mid on!
shot! Width offered on a length, and that is all Bethell needs. He throws his hands at it and scorches it through point!
on a length on middle and leg. Bethell comes half forward and turns it towards mid wicket
back of a length, nipping into off. Kohli dead-bats it and the ball bounces up over the stumps. Bethell is swift enough to pinch a single
another beauty! Fullish outside off and this shapes away late. Kohli goes nibbling at it away from his body and is beaten all ends up
shorter outside off. Bethell skips down the track and dabs it behind point to get off the mark
peach! Back of a length in the channel and this nips away sharply. Bethell goes feeling for it and sees the ball whiz past the outside edge

crashed over cover, and Rashid seals the deal for the Titans! A fitting blow to end what was largely a very convincing display. Suyash tries to pull the length back outside off. Rashid, having advanced, reaches out and slams it away. Lots of handshakes in the GT camp - they know they have turned up tonight, and they have outwitted the defending champions rather comfortably in the end!
tossed up full outside off. Rashid gets down on the sweep and belts it past square leg, who does get a hand to it and takes the sting out of the stroke
dragged down on middle and leg. Tewatia hops back and tugs it towards deep square leg
shortish outside off. Tewatia hops back and cuts it behind point. Back for another brace
nicely done! Floated up into the slot outside off, bowled from around the wicket. Tewatia goes through the line and lofts it over extra cover!
dug in short outside off. Rashid ducks under it quite early
hard length just outside off. Rashid, cramped for room, chunks it back to the bowler
back of a length, angling into off from around the wicket. Tewatia nudges it into the square leg region
fuller just outside off. Rashid pushes it to mid off and dashes across to the other end
back of a length outside off. Tewatia runs it down to deep third
back of a length just outside off. Tewatia presses half forward and dabs it towards backward point

banged in short outside off. Tewatia sways out of the way and the wide is called on height. RCB deliberate, and Patidar reviews. Well, they have a review left. Why not chance your luck. Top of the batter's head is measured at 1.75m, and the ball passes at 1.79m. RCB out of reviews!
googly on a length just outside off. Rashid gets forward and blocks

dragged to deep mid wicket, and is there life in this game still?! Suyash dangles the carrot on a full length on middle. Holder picks the googly and slogs at it. Reaches out a little too much in front, though, and drags it straight down Padikkal's throat. GT six down now!
googly on a length outside off. Tewatia comes forward and nurdles it into the point region
angled in on a length down leg. Tewatia swings at it and misses, Jitesh gets his glove to it and ensures it is just a solitary bye
fizzed through full on off. Holder has a poke at it and edges it down to short third
googly on a length just outside off. Holder reads it out of the hand, lunges forward and defends with the full face of the bat
back of a length on off. Tewatia works it towards deep mid wicket
a bit of a shank, but enough to mid wicket's right! The fielder would have been bvery interested initially. Holder chalked his pull but managed to find the gap
short ball outside off and this seems to bounce a little more than Holder expects. He swipes at it and only swats away a few flies
short outside off. Tewatia gets on top of the bounce and cuts it towards sweeper cover
low full toss on the stumps. Holder drives it to long on
into the blockhole on middle and off. Holder jams down on it and keeps it out
slower ball on a length outside off. Tewatia has a wild mow at it and drags it into the on side
back of a length outside off, bowled from around the wicket. Tewatia goes back and cuts it towards deep point
ambitious from Tewatia, but he gets what he wants! Slowed up a little on a fullish length on middle. Tewatia brings out the reverse and slaps it behind point!
dragged down and punished! A real hit-me ball and the last thing RCB want at this stage. Sits up outside leg and Tewatia bulldozes it past deep mid wicket!
lbw shout, not given! Googly on a full length on off. Tewatia misses the sweep and gets pinged on the front pad. May have been sliding beyond off
googly on a full length just outside off. Tewatia wants to drop and run to point but his partner is not as interested
fired in full on leg. Holder gets onto the front foot and knocks it to long on
four more! Full ball on the pads and this is too much on the pads. Tewatia gets a faint tickle on it and finds the fine leg fence!
back of a length outside off. Holder takes a step down the track before running it down to deep third
Holder goes big first ball! Dug into the track again, just outside off. Holder walks inside the line, and hooks it over fine leg!

RCB plead and plead and plead, but the umpire says no! RCB review! Back of a length on middle and off, and this skids through. Sundar is late on the stroke and gets pinged on the back leg. Might be a little high, but Sundar could still be in trouble if he has not hit it. No bat involved. Ball Tracking comes up and...it shows the ball to be crashing into off stump. Shepherd turning it around, and GT are crumbling!
back of a length on middle and off. Tewatia drops it into the mid wicket region and gets off the mark
another short ball on leg stump. Tewatia ducks under it without much fuss

goes a mile up, and taken! Shepherd tests out the middle of the track outside off. Shahrukh has a wild swipe at it and the ball skews off the top edge. Swirls in the air for an eternity and when the ball does come down, Hazlewood is ready at fine leg to clasp his hands around it. GT not out of the woods yet!
banged in short just outside off, after seeing the batter advance. Shahrukh adjusts and pushes it enough to the bowler's right for a single
shot! Zipped in on a length on middle and off. Shahrukh dances down the track and pummels it over mid off. Not fully off the middle but well beyond the fielder!
length ball on the pads. Sundar comes onto the front foot and flicks it towards deep square leg
back of a length on middle and leg. Shahrukh tucks it off his hips towards deep backward square leg
back of a length on middle and off. Shahrukh gets up on his toes and dabs it towards backward point
fullish and hung up wide outside off. Shahrukh has a flat-footed waft at it and only grabs a handful of fresh air

palmed over the bar! Banged into the track on off. Sundar lifts up his front leg Calypso style and whips a pull towards deep square. Iyer comes in far too much and has to then back-pedal, and can only push it over the fence with his left hand while leaping at it!
fullish just outside off. Sundar comes forward tentatively and prods it towards the bowler
back of a length outside off. Sundar gets up on his toes and punches it towards mid off
back of a length outside off. Shahrukh dabs it towards backward point, whose slight fumble allows the single
back of a length outside off. Sundar sits back and short-arm-jabs it towards long on
back of a length outside off. Sundar gets up on his toes and jabs it towards backward point
back of a length on middle and off. Sundar waits for it before glancing it down to fine leg
back of a length just outside off. Sundar presses half forward and pokes it towards extra cover
shortish outside off. Shahrukh throws his hands at it and cuts it down to deep third

bowled'im round his legs, and Bhuvneshwar is off on his celebratory run! Zipped in full on middle and leg. Buttler pre-meditates the shuffle across and goes too far across this time. Cannot catch up to this full ball and Buttler seems his leg stump flat on the ground. RCB with a big, big wicket, but has the damage already been done?
back of a length outside off. Buttler shimmies across again before turning it just behind square. Back for a couple of runs
what timing! Back of a length just outside off. Buttler moves across his stumps and clips it delightfully past mid wicket!
back of a length on off. Buttler eases it out to sweeper cover and retains strike
googly on a length outside off. Sundar presses half forward and punches it towards sweeper cover
fired in on a length on middle and leg. Buttler stays back and pushes it towards long on
slices this one a little more, but he still clears the fence comfortably! Full again and outside off. Maybe not entirely off the middle but it does not matter. Launched over long off!
Buttler is not holding back! Flighted up full on leg, and this is right into Buttler's wheelhouse. He brings out the golf swing and hoists it over the bowler's head!
fullish and sliding down leg. Buttler misses his sweep and Jitesh does well to get something behind it
googly floated up full and wide. Sundar reaches out and drives it towards sweeper cover
clean as a whistle! Pushed into the slot on off. Buttler transfers his weight forward, swings through the line and bangs it over mid on!
over the top! Back of a length outside off. Buttler plants his front foot, frees his arms and pops it over mid off!
back of a length just outside off. Buttler presses half forward and prods it into the on side
back of a length outside off and this seams away. Buttler goes chasing after it without any footwork and gets beaten on the outside
back of a length outside off. Sundar opens his bat face and runs it down to deep third
short and wide outside off. Buttler gets on top of the bounce and cuts it towards deep backward point

smashed straight to Kohli at extra cover, and Kohli throws the ball into the turf after taking it! Back of a length on middle and leg. Gill steps down and absolutely laces it. Hits it straight to Kohli, though, and his frustration is evident as he hurls the ball into the ground. Gill departs after an 18-ball 43, and RCB getting their teeth stuck into this contest now!
back of a length outside off. Buttler walks down and bunts it to mid off. Scampers across to complete the single this time
back of a length outside off. Buttler skips down and looks to go inside-out. Only swishes at thin air, though
back of a length just outside off. Buttler gets behind the line and defends
back of a length outside off. Buttler walks down the track and pushes it towards cover point

back of a length on off. Gill tips it to extra cover and calls for the single. Kohli swoops in, dives to his right and in one motion, flicks it at the bowler's end. Gill would have been short had Kohli hit
if you do not succeed at first, try again ft. Jos Buttler! Back of a length on off. Buttler shimmies across early and laps it clean over the fine leg fence!

nicked and Jitesh drops an absolute soda! Dug in short outside off. Buttler pre-meditates the scoop and walks across. Gloves it and Jitesh cannot hold on to a regulation chance high to his right. Very, very presentable chance!
back of a length outside off. Gill presses half forward and runs it down to deep backward point
back of a length outside off. Buttler drops it into the point region and opens his account

back of a length just outside off. Gill has a tentative poke at it and chunks it off the inside edge into his body. The ball rolls away and Kohli, who picks it up, fires a needless throw at the bowler's end. Misses it by a mile and there is no one backing up. Four bonus runs for GT!
speared in full and wide outside off. Gill steps out and backs away, and is too far from the ball in the end. Has to let it go

nicked and taken! Bhuvneshwar strikes, and a huge roar follows! Not sure at this exact point whose home ground this is, judging by the reaction. Fullish in the channel and this seams away. Sudharsan pokes at it with hard hands and the ball floats through to the keeper, who dives to his left and snares the chance superbly. RCB on the board after taking a bit of tap!
back of a length outside off. Gill waits for it and nurdles it into the point region
shortish on middle and off. Gill looks for that favoured short-arm-jab but jams it off the inside edge into his body

RCB think there is bat involved, and RCB review! Pulls the length back just outside leg. Gill hares down and swishes at it. Seems to miss it but RCB reckon the ball may have grazed the outside edge. Kohli and Bhuvneshwar were the instigators, as far as the review is concerned, but both have gotten it wrong. Flat line on UltraEdge, and Gill survives!
hard length on middle and off. Sudharsan, having advanced, stabs it into the on side
more runs! Length ball outside off. Sudharsan throws his hands at it and gets an outside edge that hurtles past short third!
more catching practice for the crowd! Full and sliding down leg. Gill picks the length and the length early, and whips it over deep backward square leg!
stop that, Shubman! This is glorious batting. On a back of a length on middle and leg. Gill backs away enough and caresses it through point!
going, going, gone! Angled into the slot on off, and Gill says thank you very much. He plants his front foot and launches it over mid on!
ver full outside off. Gill jams down on it and digs it out towards the bowler
this is even better! A touch fuller but still on a length on middle and leg. Gill marches down, creates room and lifts it over extra cover!
Gill greets him with a royal flay over point! Back of a length on middle and off. Gill steps out to the leg side and scythes it away!
back of a length outside off, nipping away with the angle. Sudharsan walks down the track before tucking his bat inside the line
back of a length on middle and leg, and this shapes away late too. Gill gets squared up and plonks it off the leading edge towards deep backward point
jaffa! This is a contest and a half. Back of a length in the channel. Threatens to shape in before swerving away. Gill is opened up completely and beaten on the outside
up, up and away! Some way to respond to an inside edge. Full and searching for swing outside off. Gill plants his front foot and smacks it over mid off!
cut in half, but Gill has some luck going his way! Back of a length in the channel and this snakes back in. Gill has a stab at it and the ball flies off the inside edge past the keeper!
back of a length, shaping into off. Sudharsan drops it with soft hands into the silly point region and calls his skipper through for the single
